summary.text: R. Jason Goodman is the Democratic candidate for Tennessee House of Representatives District 41 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent Ed Butler; he is an electrical engineer who worked for the Tennessee Valley Authority for 31 years.

paragraphs.text: R. Jason Goodman earned a high school diploma from Wartburg Central High School and a bachelor's degree from Tennessee Tech University in 1983, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as electrical engineer.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in Morgan County, returned to live there in 2010, is a licensed professional electrical engineer in Tennessee, and worked for TVA for 31 years as a field test engineer and manager of a Transmission Service Center.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on August 6, 2026.
Goodman's survey listed expanding Medicaid in Tennessee, funding public schools and not private schools, and childcare assistance and grocery tax relief as his key messages.
He also named improving Highway 62 in District 41 as a priority.
